name: Albanyà (Spain)
description: Red field with a blue lozenge at the centre, over which lie a white bend sinister and a yellow bend crossing in saltire.
history: The flag was approved on 15 January 2002 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, red, with a blue diamond at the centre separated from the corners by 1/6 of the height, over all a white bend sinister of 1/6 and over that a yellow bend of the same width.

features.role: lozenge separated from the corners by 1/6 of the height
bend sinister 1/6 wide over the lozenge
bend 1/6 wide over the bend sinister
